newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indesen Industries mulls rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Indesen Industries mulls rights issue.

text.p: Video cassette maker Indesen Industries Co Ltd said on Monday it was considering a rights issue to enlarge and strengthen the company's capital base.
"It is now a suitable time to consider a rights issue to enlarge and strengthen the company's capital base and certain investment proposals," Indesen said in a statement.
It said the investment proposals related to repairs and maintenance of motor vehicles and trading of related spare parts in addition to its existing video tape business.
"The proposed rights issue is at a preliminary stage and no specific terms and conditions have been concluded at present," it said.
Trading in the Indesen shares resumed on Monday after the company requested a suspension on Friday morning.
The shares were down HK$0.23 to HK$0.93 at midday.
